about: Crash pitfall catalogue, one pack per platform. Pitfalls with a regex are found by scripts/scan_pitfalls.py (pattern confidence only); the rest come from tools, the contract diff or the agent's own reading. 'tools' lists rule ids in other analysers that find the same pitfall, so SARIF results can be mapped back to a pitfall. Window fields: suppress_before/suppress_after drop a hit when that regex appears within 'window' lines before/after it (e.g. a surrounding try); require_before keeps a hit only when that regex appears within the window before it.

pitfalls.title: Unguarded access to optional or nullable data
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The API returns an empty array, null or a missing key for a field the code dereferences (data.items[0].name with items: []).
pitfalls.fix: Guard at the access (optional chaining with a fallback) or validate the response at the data-layer boundary (zod, io-ts, valibot) so bad shapes fail in one handled place.

pitfalls.title: JSON.parse without try/catch
pitfalls.trigger_hint: Persisted state, a query parameter or a response body is not valid JSON (written by an older version, truncated by quota, or a plain string).
pitfalls.fix: Wrap the parse in try/catch with a safe default, and when the value is persisted, discard or migrate it instead of re-throwing on every launch.

pitfalls.title: TypeScript non-null assertion hides a null
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The asserted value is null or undefined at runtime (element not found, query not loaded, find() with no match).
pitfalls.fix: Replace the assertion with a real check and a handled fallback.

pitfalls.title: Cast through any or unknown hides the real shape
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The value does not have the shape the code then assumes.
pitfalls.fix: Validate the value (type guard or schema) instead of casting.

pitfalls.title: Invalid Date reaches a throwing Date method
pitfalls.note: new Date() with no argument (the current time) cannot be Invalid Date and is not matched.
pitfalls.trigger_hint: A date string the engine can't parse (empty, null, or a non-ISO format some browsers reject) produces Invalid Date; toISOString then throws RangeError.
pitfalls.fix: Check isNaN(date.getTime()) before formatting, or parse with a library that returns a result type.

pitfalls.title: Number or string method called on a value that can be null
pitfalls.note: Not matched when the same line guards the value (x != null ? x.toFixed(...), typeof x === 'number', (x ?? 0).toFixed, Number(x).toFixed) or the receiver is always a number (Math.max(...).toFixed, parseFloat(s).toFixed, (a / b).toFixed: arithmetic on null gives 0 or NaN, and NaN.toFixed does not throw), nor when one of the two lines before checks isNaN / Number.isFinite.
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The number is null or undefined (no rating yet, price not loaded) and toFixed throws TypeError.
pitfalls.fix: Format through a helper that handles null, and show a placeholder.

pitfalls.title: Intl formatter built from data that can be invalid
pitfalls.note: A formatter built from a constant locale and constant options (all on one line) cannot throw and is not matched.
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The locale, currency code or time zone comes from the user or the API and is invalid or empty; the constructor throws RangeError.
pitfalls.fix: Validate the code against a known list, or construct inside try/catch with a fallback locale.

pitfalls.title: Throwing parser fed with untrusted input
pitfalls.trigger_hint: A malformed percent-encoding in the URL (URIError), user text with regex metacharacters (SyntaxError), or a relative or empty URL (TypeError).
pitfalls.fix: Escape user text before building a RegExp, and wrap decoding and URL parsing in try/catch.

pitfalls.title: reduce() without an initial value
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The array is empty; reduce with no initial value throws TypeError.
pitfalls.fix: Pass an initial value.

pitfalls.title: Web storage used without handling failure
pitfalls.trigger_hint: Storage is blocked (third-party iframe, strict privacy settings) and access throws SecurityError, or setItem exceeds the quota.
pitfalls.fix: Access storage through a wrapper that catches and falls back to memory.

pitfalls.title: Browser-only API at module scope in server-rendered code
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The module is evaluated during server rendering where window is undefined (ReferenceError).
pitfalls.fix: Move the access into an effect or guard with typeof window !== 'undefined'.

pitfalls.title: Promise chain without a rejection handler
pitfalls.matcher_note: The whole chain is parsed across lines, from its receiver to the end of the statement. It is handled when any link is .catch(...) or .then(onFulfilled, onRejected), or when the chain is returned, awaited, yielded, an arrow function's body, or passed straight to a call or array (waitUntil, Promise.all), whose owner then answers for the rejection. .finally() does not handle a rejection.
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The request fails (HTTP 500, offline); the rejection is unhandled. Usually B4, but B1/B2 when a later render depends on the result.
pitfalls.fix: Handle the rejection and show an error state.

pitfalls.title: Render tree, route or third-party widget with no error boundary
pitfalls.trigger_hint: Any render-time throw below the unprotected node unmounts the whole tree (white screen).
pitfalls.fix: Add a root boundary and per-route boundaries; wrap third-party widgets in their own boundary.

pitfalls.title: State update during render, or an effect whose dependencies change on every render
pitfalls.trigger_hint: A render sets state unconditionally, or an effect depends on an object recreated each render: 'Maximum update depth exceeded' or a frozen tab.
pitfalls.fix: Move the update into an event or effect with stable dependencies (useMemo/useCallback).

pitfalls.title: Response applied after the component unmounted or after a newer request
pitfalls.trigger_hint: Fast navigation: an older, slower response arrives last and overwrites state with the wrong shape for the current screen.
pitfalls.fix: Abort on unmount (AbortController) and ignore responses that aren't the latest.

pitfalls.title: Server and client render different markup
pitfalls.trigger_hint: Time, random values, locale or storage read during render differ between server and client.
pitfalls.fix: Render environment-dependent values after mount.

pitfalls.title: API not available in a declared browser target
pitfalls.trigger_hint: A browser in the browserslist range lacks the API (structuredClone, Array.prototype.at, Object.hasOwn) and the call throws TypeError.
pitfalls.fix: Polyfill or feature-detect, or narrow the browser targets deliberately.

pitfalls.title: Unbounded recursion, unvirtualised huge list or catastrophic regex
pitfalls.trigger_hint: Deeply nested or cyclic data, a 10,000-item response, or a long input string against a backtracking regex: stack overflow or a hung tab.
pitfalls.fix: Bound recursion, virtualise long lists, and use linear-time regexes.

pitfalls.title: Kotlin !! on a value that can be null
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The value is null at runtime (missing intent extra, absent JSON field, view accessed after onDestroyView): NullPointerException.
pitfalls.fix: Use ?.let / ?: with a handled fallback, or requireNotNull with a message at a validated boundary.

pitfalls.title: Unsafe cast (as instead of as?)
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The object is a different type (another fragment host, another adapter item type): ClassCastException.
pitfalls.fix: Use as? and handle null.

pitfalls.title: lateinit property that can be read before it is set
pitfalls.trigger_hint: A callback reads the property before onCreate/onViewCreated sets it, or after process death restores the screen without it: UninitializedPropertyAccessException.
pitfalls.fix: Initialise in the constructor or use a nullable property; check ::prop.isInitialized where order isn't guaranteed.

pitfalls.title: Number parsing of external input without handling failure
pitfalls.trigger_hint: A deep-link or intent parameter, or a server string, isn't a number: NumberFormatException.
pitfalls.fix: Use toIntOrNull()/toLongOrNull() and handle null.

pitfalls.title: Blocking call that can run on the main thread
pitfalls.trigger_hint: Slow network or disk while the call runs on the main thread: Application Not Responding (ANR) after 5 seconds.
pitfalls.fix: Move the work to a coroutine on Dispatchers.IO and update the UI on completion.

pitfalls.title: Fragment transaction committed without regard to saved state
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The transaction runs from an async callback after onSaveInstanceState (user backgrounded the app): IllegalStateException.
pitfalls.fix: Commit only while the lifecycle is at least STARTED (lifecycleScope + repeatOnLifecycle) or use commitAllowingStateLoss deliberately.

pitfalls.title: Full-size bitmap decode
pitfalls.trigger_hint: A large photo from the camera or gallery is decoded at full resolution: OutOfMemoryError.
pitfalls.fix: Decode with inSampleSize, or use an image library (Coil, Glide) that downsamples.

pitfalls.title: Missing permission-denied handling
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The user denies or revokes a runtime permission and the code uses the API anyway: SecurityException.
pitfalls.fix: Check the grant result and handle denial and 'don't ask again'.

pitfalls.title: State lost on process death
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The OS kills the backgrounded process; the restored screen reads a singleton or ViewModel field that is now empty.
pitfalls.fix: Persist critical state in SavedStateHandle and handle its absence.

pitfalls.title: API used below its minimum SDK
pitfalls.trigger_hint: A device on an Android version between minSdkVersion and the API's level: NoSuchMethodError.
pitfalls.fix: Guard with Build.VERSION.SDK_INT or use the AndroidX compat API.

pitfalls.title: Swift force unwrap
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The optional is nil at runtime (URL(string:) on user text, a missing dictionary key, a cell that failed to dequeue): fatal error, app terminated.
pitfalls.fix: Use guard let / if let with a handled fallback.

pitfalls.title: try! on an operation that can throw
pitfalls.trigger_hint: Decoding or file access fails (unexpected JSON, missing file): fatal error.
pitfalls.fix: Use do/catch or try? with handling.

pitfalls.title: as! forced cast
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The value is another type (JSON number vs string, another view controller): fatal error.
pitfalls.fix: Use as? and handle nil.

pitfalls.title: Implicitly unwrapped optional property
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The property is read before it is assigned (a lifecycle method runs earlier than expected): fatal error.
pitfalls.fix: Make it a real optional or initialise it in init.

pitfalls.title: fatalError or preconditionFailure in reachable code
pitfalls.trigger_hint: A server sends a new enum value or an unexpected state reaches a default branch that calls fatalError.
pitfalls.fix: Handle unknown cases with a fallback (an .unknown case in the decoded enum).

pitfalls.title: Array subscript without a bounds check
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The array is empty: fatal error 'Index out of range'.
pitfalls.fix: Use .first or a safe subscript.

pitfalls.title: UIKit used off the main thread
pitfalls.trigger_hint: A URLSession or background-queue completion updates views directly: Main Thread Checker violation, crash or corrupted layout.
pitfalls.fix: Hop to the main actor (@MainActor, DispatchQueue.main.async) before touching UI.

pitfalls.title: API newer than the deployment target
pitfalls.trigger_hint: A device on an older iOS version within the deployment target: crash on launch or when the screen opens.
pitfalls.fix: Guard with if #available.

pitfalls.title: Dart null-check operator (!) on a value that can be null
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The value is null at runtime: 'Null check operator used on a null value', which replaces the widget with the error widget or a grey screen in release.
pitfalls.fix: Handle null explicitly (?? fallback, if-null check) instead of asserting.

pitfalls.title: BuildContext or setState used after an await without a mounted check
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The user leaves the screen while the awaited call is in flight; the widget is disposed when the code resumes.
pitfalls.fix: Check if (!mounted) return; (or context.mounted) after every await.

pitfalls.title: Throwing parse of external input
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The string isn't in the expected format: FormatException.
pitfalls.fix: Use tryParse and handle null, or catch FormatException.

pitfalls.title: first/last/single on a collection that can be empty
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The list is empty: StateError 'No element'.
pitfalls.fix: Use firstOrNull (package:collection) and handle null.

pitfalls.title: Cast of decoded JSON to a non-nullable type
pitfalls.trigger_hint: The key is missing or has another type in the response: TypeError ('Null' is not a subtype of 'String').
pitfalls.fix: Use generated models (json_serializable, freezed) with nullable fields where the API allows null.
